title: SliceNormalizedTensorTransport
statement: Let C be an arbitrary site and R a commutative ring sheaf, with module sheafification and locally-bijective compatibility in the stated universes. With the actual scalar extension and ordinary tensor of [def-sf-slice-tensor-generator-interfaces], there exists, simultaneously for every unital R-algebra sheaf A, a natural isomorphism t_A: (- tensor_R A) ≅ extend(A.hom) ⋙ Res_A, such that t_A sends the original sheafified pure tensor m tensor s to scalarExtensionSection(A.hom,M,W,s,m). This holds on an arbitrary site, so applies also to every slice site satisfying the same instances.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03CY, 03EK and 0E8I; extraction of the scalar, tensor transport and strict tower steps of lem-sf-cbc-slice-tensor-generator-coherence.

proof.text: On presheaves use tensor symmetry to identify M tensor S with the underlying R-module of S tensor M. The balanced relations are precisely those of scalar extension. This identification commutes with restriction maps and with maps of M. Sheafification commutes with scalar restriction: both have the same underlying abelian sheafification and the same uniquely extended action. Sheafify the presheaf identification and compose with this comparison. The sheafification-unit equations give the displayed formula on pure tensors. Naturality follows by comparing these formulas, since pure tensors generate before sheafification and the adjunction detects maps after sheafification. This argument applies to any site, including the slice site.
